sloka: उपायो दृश्यताम् कश्चित् लंघने लवण अंभसः ।अभिगम्य तु वैदेहीम् समृद्ध अर्था गमिष्यथ ॥४-५८-३४॥
transliteration: upāyo dṛśyatām kaścit laṁghane lavaṇa aṁbhasaḥ ।abhigamya tu vaidehīm samṛddha arthā gamiṣyatha ॥4-58-34॥

translations.english: 'Look out for some means to cross the salty ocean. You will see Vaidehi, and return, your mission accomplished.
